# xssprober

Source: https://github.com/connorjaydunn/xssprober/blob/main/README.md

# xssprober
*xssprober* is an open-source penetration testing tool designed to automate the detection of XSS vulnerabilities. The primary philosophy of xssprober is to scan as much as possible, as quickly as possible. It attains this goal via techniques such as **Asynchronous Programming** and **Single-Request-Muti-Parameter-Probing**. Results obtained from xssprober can be piped into more "aggressive" tooling such as [XSStrike](https://github.com/s0md3v/XSStrike). xssprober only detects vulnerabilities, it will **not** exploit them.

For more information regarding the inner workings of xssprober and examples of **real world** XSS vulnerabilities, read this [blog post](https://connorjaydunn.github.io/blog/posts/xssprober-blazing-fast-xss-detection/).

Features
----
* Asynchronous Scanning
* Single Request Multi Parameter Probing
* Targeted Scanning
* Dork-Based Scanning
* Hidden-Parameter Scanning
* 350+ Default Hidden Parameter Wordlist (`params.txt`)

Screenshots
----

![](docs/demo.png)

Installation
----

**1.** Clone the repository:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/connorjaydunn/xssprober.git
```

**2.** Navigate to the project directory:

```bash
cd xssprober
```

**3.** Install dependencies:

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

Usage
----

To view all available options and parameters, run:

```bash
python xssprober.py -h
```

Examples
----

```bash
python xssprober.py -u "https://127.0.0.1/blog.php?id=32" -p params.txt
```

This will:

- Scan the target `https://127.0.0.1/blog.php?id=32`,
- Test for hidden parameters specified in `params.txt`.

```bash
python xssprober.py -q "inurl:login.php" -s 20 -n 30 -c 10 -p params.txt
```

This will:

- Search Google using the query `inurl:login.php`,
- Collect `30` results starting from page `20`,
- Use a maximum of `10` concurrent connections,
- Test for hidden parameters specified in `params.txt`.
